title: Stakes Winner 2: Saikyouba Densetsu
native_title: ステークス・ウィナー２ ～最強馬伝説～
overview:
The strongest horses race across the world stage! Seize the glory of being the world's best!

Includes an "Arcade Mode" (two types, domestic and overseas) that fully reproduces the arcade version, plus a powered-up version of the popular breeding and training mode. Compete in overseas races and create the legend of the world's strongest horse!

Real Jockey Action 2

最強馬が世界を舞台に疾走する!つかめ世界一の栄光を!

アーケード版を完全再現した“アーケードモード”(国内海外の2種)と好評の種付け育成モードもパワーアップして搭載。海外レースを転戦し、世界最強馬の伝説を創りだせ!

REAL JOCKEY ACTION 2
